liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Here Comes Sunshine** (2 reviews): Here Comes Sunshine is singled out as a highlight, alongside a ripping Playing in the Band; Reviewer calls Sunshine and Eyes the best versions before November 1973 [9][16]
- **Bertha** (1 review): Bertha and Box of Rain are played with high energy [10]
- **Tennessee Jed** (1 review): Tennessee Jed is up-tempo with plenty of twang [10]
- **Row Jimmy** (1 review): Harmonies in Row Jimmy are surprisingly good [17]
- **Truckin'** (1 review): Truckin'>Other One>Eyes>Stella Blue>Sugar Magnolia sequence is called spectacular [19]
- **The Other One** (1 review): Other One is solid; Jerry's voice wobbles but he steps up at key moments [9]
- **Eyes Of The World** (1 review): Eyes is described as a kaleidoscope of colors and primal energy [9]

## The recordings

- **gd73-05-20.sbd-patched.schlissel.24495.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 33 songs; 219 min; rated 4.74/5 by 19 [1]. Said about its sound: Patched soundboard is very well patched, Here Comes Sunshine especially [17]
- **gd73-05-20.sbd.weiner-warner.19564.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 33 songs; 219 min; rated 4.31/5 by 16 [3]. Said about its sound: Soundboard is slightly light on bass, though Billy's drumming comes through prominently; Soundboard has some irritating audience-recording patches throughout, though the overall effect remains dazzling [8][10]
- **gd73-05-20.aud.weiner.gdADT.5915.sbefail.shnf**: audience recording; 33 songs; 230 min; rated 4.75/5 by 8 [4]
- **gd1973-05-20.sbd.miller.86905.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 32 songs; 218 min; rated 4.69/5 by 13 [5]. Said about its sound: Uploader cleaned up flaws and fixed levels; the first few notes of Greatest Story are clipped [5]
- **gd73-05-20.set3-sbd.cribbs.16531.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 8 songs; 67 min; rated 1.5/5 by 2 [6]. Said about its sound: Set 3 soundboard is a bit low in level with mild hiss, but sounds pretty good [12]
- **gd1973-05-20.sbd-set3.wow.16158.shnf**: soundboard; 8 songs; 67 min [7]. Said about its sound: Set 3 has PA static or feedback in Truckin', a splice in Eyes, a digital hiccup at Stella's start and a level drop [7]

## Around the show

- Reviewer was a UCSB sophomore; day was sunny, warm and breezy at the stadium, with over 20,000 fans [15]
- UCSB had dropped its football program about a year and a half earlier [15]
- Jerry sang with a bad cold, and his guitar leads were crisp, tight and potent [16]
- Jerry has an audible cold, and seems to have compensated with sharper guitar playing [18]
- Reviewer considers it one of the most energetic performances of 1973 [8]
- Truckin'>Other One>Eyes resembles the 5/13 and 5/26 versions; 5/13 and 5/20 are about equal, Kezar 5/26 maybe better [14]
- Jerry's tone is less lush than at the end of 1973, when he used different guitars [16]
- Reviewer finds the playing much better than at Kezar [18]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd73-05-20.sbd-patched.schlissel.24495.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [1]. Also: Patched soundboard from 7-inch master reels at 7.5ips half-track, through DAT transfers to CD and extraction [1]
- **gd73-05-20.sbd.weiner-warner.19564.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [3]
- **gd73-05-20.aud.weiner.gdADT.5915.sbefail.shnf**: source: Audience Recording: Sony Condenser [4]. Also: Reviewer of the audience recording advises getting the soundboard instead [14]
- **gd1973-05-20.sbd.miller.86905.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Reel (7 inch reels @ 7.5ips 1/2trk) -> Dat -> CD D [5]. Also: Soundboard patched with a Sony mic master cassette source, through reel, cassette and DAT to CD, filling several gaps [5]
- **gd73-05-20.set3-sbd.cribbs.16531.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [6]
- **gd1973-05-20.sbd-set3.wow.16158.shnf**: transferred by Sly Wow; source: SBD>MR>C>DAT>CDR [7]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Bob Marks Grateful Dead: [1973-05-20 Stadium, UC Santa Barbara, Santa Barbara, CA, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1973-05-20-stadium-uc-santa-barbara-santa-barbara-ca-usa/) [21]
